svg.text: Design, implementation, review and reporting · every phase
Delegated implementation runs on the node folders
In-editor edits and refactors across the tree
Second opinion on the detector and the ONNX export
Prompting, judgement, and taking the blame
Shares are weighted effort, not commit count — each workstream is weighted by its size,
then apportioned between its contributors. The ring around each badge is that contributor’s slice.
